reviews.text:
A truly negative experience and, above all, a gross lack of professionalism.

This morning I learned that Farmina N&D Pappy was available at Arcaplanet in Brenta. In the afternoon, around 6:00 PM, I went to the store in Piazza Bonomelli/Brenta to purchase it, also using a Farmina discount coupon.

At the checkout, Luca, the employee, told me that Pappy wasn't available and directed me to go to the store in Piazzale Ovidio/Marco Bruto, telling me I'd find it there.

I then specifically drove to Marco Bruto, braving traffic, time, and travel costs. When I arrived at the store, a young woman showed me the aisle. After searching, I asked her again where the Pappy was, explaining that I'd been sent there specifically by the Brenta store.

At that point, it turned out that they didn't have the 12 kg Farmina N&D Pappy there either. I was looking for a specific protein, but the even more absurd thing was that not even a 12-kg Pappy pack with any of the other proteins in the line was available. Essentially, they didn't have any variants of that product available.

Marco Bruto's colleague then called the Brenta store to check on the situation. No one apologized for making me go from store to store, and, more importantly, no one actually tried to find a solution.

The problem isn't that a product might be out of stock: it can happen. The problem is the complete lack of problem-solving and customer service. I wasn't offered the option of checking availability at other stores, ordering the product, having it delivered to my home, or any other alternative.

In the end, I had to go to Animali Armo, where I found the product, used the Farmina coupon, and even explained that if the product wasn't available, they would order it and ship it to my home.

Here's the difference: the problem isn't not having a product in store. The problem is sending a customer from one store to another without checking, wasting their time and money, and then being unable to find a solution.

I would have expected much more professionalism from a chain like Arcaplanet.
